items.title: jingyaogong/minimind
items.contentSnippet:
🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours.
https://jingyaogong.github.io/minimind

 
 

 
 
 
 
     
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
"大道至简"
 
 
 
 
中文 | English
 
 
 
 
此开源项目旨在完全从 0 开始，仅用 3 块钱成本与 2 小时训练时间，即可训练出规模约为 64M 的超小语言模型 MiniMind。
 
 
MiniMind 系列极其轻量，主线最小版本体积约为 GPT-3 的 $\frac{1}{2700}$，力求让普通个人 GPU 也能快速完成训练与复现。
 
 
项目同时开源了大模型的极简结构与完整训练链路，覆盖 MoE、数据清洗、预训练（Pretrain）、监督微调（SFT）、LoRA、RLHF（DPO）、RLAIF（PPO / GRPO / CISPO）、Tool Use、Agentic RL、自适应思考与模型蒸馏等全过程代码。

items.title: Show HN: Scheduling a Simulated Vertical Farm
items.contentSnippet:
A 3D simulation of a vertical lettuce farm I built at a hackathon. It runs entirely in the browser. Two copies of the same farm run side by side one on fixed schedules, one with a scheduler that times harvests from scan data and plans the lights around real electricity prices. In the simulation, the scheduled farm uses about 20% less electricity per kg of sellable lettuce.
source: https://github.com/taneron/vertical-farm-twin

items.title: Show HN: I've made a CVE auto pentest app
items.contentSnippet:
I've made this website to pentest your own vibecoded apps fleet.
It handles automatically cve tracking from https://cve.now/ and for each of them add them as a new attack in an engine.
It can even launch its own sandbox with sub agents that tests IDOR attacks etc. I'm sure it can be very handy as Claude subscriptions would otherswise flag quickly any of your coding sessions for cyber safeguards rails.
I'd appreciate any suggestions or feedback !

items.title: Show HN: Rico: Rich Markdown Reviews for GitHub PRs
items.contentSnippet:

I tried to close that gap a bit after trying out a few different solutions.
